A short guide to handover calls at the skyport
The desk wrote this for anyone flying with an animal
Handover Calls for Animal Travel at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk arranges care from booking through pickup, and handover calls are part of that support. They help the airline, the traveler, and the ground team confirm that the animal is ready for travel and that the crate, documents, and special notes match the reservation.

Before you arrive, keep your phone close and your contact details current. A handover call may come from the desk or from the skyport team to confirm the animal's condition, the crate fit, and any handling needs. If you are traveling with a cat, <<FACT F067>> Bring the crate you will use for the flight, and make sure it is secure, clean, and easy to open for inspection. If you are traveling with a large dog, <<FACT F063>> The team will also look for clear labeling and any approved comfort items that can travel safely.

Please answer the call promptly and speak clearly. If you need help with loading, feeding notes, or a connection between flights, tell the desk as soon as possible. Respectful communication helps the team prepare the safest handover for the animal and reduces delays at the skyport.

If you arrive with a pet that seems unwell, stressed, or unable to travel as planned, let staff know at once so they can guide you to the next step. The Companion Animal Travel Desk remains available to support you from check-in to arrival, and you may contact it again for any follow-up help.
